features.name: debt_to_income_ratio
features.description: Loan amount as fraction of annual income, smooth severity measure of repayment burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of payment burden; monotonic with default risk.

features.name: log_income
features.description: Log-transformed income to compress heavy tail for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes scale; provides near-linear relationship with creditworthiness.

features.name: log_loan_amnt
features.description: Log-transformed loan amount for smoother linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew, improves SVM margin stability.

features.name: interest_burden_score
features.description: Interest rate times loan-to-income ratio, composite severity of monthly burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures interaction between rate and income load for linear margin.

features.name: credit_score_normalized
features.description: Credit score scaled to approximately [0,1] using training-data observed range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized input ideal for SVM with regularization.

features.name: employment_stability_ratio
features.description: Employment experience relative to adult age, proxy for career stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded smooth ratio useful for linear scoring.

features.name: credit_history_age_ratio
features.description: Credit history length relative to adult lifespan.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth fractional feature describing credit maturity.

features.name: income_per_emp_year
features.description: Log income normalized by employment years, capturing earning efficiency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous productivity proxy for linear weighting.

features.name: rate_above_mean_severity
features.description: How far loan interest rate exceeds dataset mean rate, measures pricing risk premium.
features.expected_model_benefit: Signed continuous deviation useful for SVM separating hyperplane.

features.name: credit_score_deficit
features.description: Shortfall of credit score below training mean, smooth penalty signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Signed margin-friendly deviation from average creditworthiness.

features.name: composite_risk_index
features.description: Weighted composite combining default history, loan-to-income, interest rate, and inverse credit score for an overall risk projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Hand-crafted approximate linear projection aligned with risk; boosts SVM margin.

features.name: borrower_creditworthiness_judgment
features.description: Semantic interpretable score combining education tier, home ownership stability, lack of defaults, and intent purpose seriousness (debt consolidation/medical considered higher-risk; education/venture moderate; home improvement lower-risk) into a continuous borrower-quality estimate not easily captured by simple ratios.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth holistic borrower-quality signal complementing numeric ratios in the linear SVM margin.
